required_events.event: Amy stirred a pot of eggs on the stove while Will and Amber giggled over their plates.
Suddenly, the front door cracked open with a groan as a zombie stepped inside, its eyes fixed on her.
She grabbed Will’s hand, pulled him toward the back window, then shoved Amber into the small closet behind the pantry where they could hide.
Amy slipped out of that closet and returned to the kitchen, stepping onto the counter.
She opened the cabinet beside the stove and drew a pistol from its drawer.
Then she slid a katana from its wall rack into her hand.
One by one she fought each zombie that burst through the door—shooting with her pistol, slashing with the blade—and more zombies kept coming as she took them down.
After the last of the zombies collapsed after being shot, Amy pushed open the closet door and pulled Will and Amber out onto the porch together.
